title: docs(adr): ADR-0135 D5.2 — a cloud-managed environment keeps no local break-glass password
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D58H4hn7mx9bRShF3BfEhTw)_

Refs #33203

> **Tier H (`docs/adr/**`).** This record lands only by the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval. It pairs with the code PR for #33203; the seat lands the two together after the maintainer's word.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0135 D5.2 加一条注记：托管环境（`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`）不再保留「应急本地密码」，任何人（含平台管理员）都不能设本地密码；自托管不变。
- 为什么改：#33203 的代码按 cloud#4465 裁决 10 关掉托管上的两个设密码入口，而 D5.2 原文写着「Break-glass keeps a local credential reachable」。按 AGENTS.md 第 13 条，推翻已接受 ADR 的行为必须同时改 ADR。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 需要你做的：同意这条注记（或改写），然后和代码 PR 一起落地。

## What changes

`docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md`: one note under D5.2. On a cloud-managed environment the break-glass bullet does not apply: `admin/set-user-password` refuses every target and `set-initial-password` refuses every signed-in caller, a platform administrator included. Self-hosted deployments keep D5.2 as written. Cloud ADR-0024's own text is not amended here.

## Why

Ruling 10 of objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 (hosted has no local break-glass administrator; no local password for anyone), quoted on #33181 and #33183. The code PR for #33203 implements it. Prime Directive #13: reversing a recorded decision needs the record amended.

## Verification

Docs only; nothing publishes, so no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (The ADR half of #33203, split so the code does not wait on the Tier H approval.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is the frame's Chinese summary.)
